item.tib: sa snying cho ga snang srid rgyan mdos kyi gzhung
item.coloph: zhes rgya yis gdab nas rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon dran pa yab yum gyis gangs can bod dang bod chen gyi sa mtshams/ spu rgyal tshe lung dpal 'bar gdong su (du) rgya yis gdab ste sbas so/ bdag 'dra rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal lam/ mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa can gyis/ sa pho 'brug gi lo la spyan drangs te rim par gtan la phab pa'o//
